subject.title: fix(release): run regular publish from trusted main

question: Should regular beta and stable publication require protected-main workflow bytes and reject privileged child runs whose head SHA differs from that trusted SHA?
rationale: This intentionally changes the release-operator compatibility contract and the authorization boundary for workflows that can publish packages and releases, so release-owner intent is required even though the implementation is technically sound.

options.title: Require trusted-main orchestration
options.body: Land the PR after required exact-head checks, making protected main the permanent workflow-code source for regular publication.

options.title: Retain release-branch orchestration
options.body: Keep the previous operator contract and accept that release branches may execute publication workflow bytes lacking newer validators.

recommendation.title: Require trusted-main orchestration
recommendation.body: Land the PR after required exact-head checks, making protected main the permanent workflow-code source for regular publication.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored both this authorization-boundary patch and the immediately preceding immutable-evidence implementation.
